verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Mixpanel serves an llms.txt at docs.mixpanel.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200). It is structured as an index linking to markdown (.md) versions of doc pages, so an agent can be pointed at it directly. The many docs citations served from .md URLs corroborate that agent-friendly markdown docs exist. Missing for 10: evidence of an llms-full.txt or explicit first-party documentation describing agent-oriented docs usage, and independent corroboration of agents using it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
